title: Security Officer Jobs in Aster Medcity - Kadamakkudy, Kerala, India
description:
**Job Requirements**
 Job Title: Security Officer Jobs in Aster Medcity \- Kadamakkudy, Kerala
   

  

 Company: Aster Medcity
   

  

 Location: Kadamakkudy, Kerala, India
   

  

 Salary: Best in Industry
   

  

 Qualification: Minimum 10th Grade Education
   

  

 Experience: 1\-4 Years of Security Experience
   

  

**Job Description**
 Aster Medcity, a leading healthcare institution in Kadamakkudy, Kerala, is seeking dedicated Security Officers to join our esteemed security team. As a Security Officer at Aster Medcity, you will be responsible for ensuring the safety and security of our healthcare environment. This role involves protecting patients, staff, and property, and maintaining a secure facility. If you are committed to safety and have relevant experience, this opportunity is for you.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Safeguard the premises and patients at Aster Medcity to ensure a secure environment.
* Monitor access points and conduct security checks to detect and prevent unauthorized activities.
* Respond promptly to security incidents and emergencies, taking necessary actions to resolve issues efficiently.
* Maintain accurate records of security\-related activities and incidents to support effective security management.
* Collaborate with local authorities and emergency services when required to ensure a coordinated response.
* Conduct regular patrols and inspections of the facility to ensure all areas comply with safety protocols.
* Operate and monitor security equipment such as CCTV cameras and alarm systems.
* Assist in training new security staff and provide support to team members as needed.
* Ensure adherence to safety and security policies and procedures at all times within Aster Medcity.
* Provide exceptional customer service to patients and visitors, addressing their safety concerns effectively.


**Requirements**
* Minimum 10th\-grade education required for the Security Officer role at Aster Medcity.
* 1\-4 years of security experience, preferably within a healthcare or institutional setting.
* Strong communication and observation skills essential for managing and reporting security issues.
* Proficiency in handling security equipment, including surveillance cameras and alarm systems.
* Commitment to maintaining a safe environment for all individuals at Aster Medcity.
* Ability to respond to emergencies quickly and effectively, demonstrating a proactive approach to security.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the capacity to handle stressful situations calmly and professionally.
* A reliable and dedicated work ethic, with a focus on teamwork and collaboration.


**Benefits**
* Competitive Compensation Package: Receive a salary that is best in the industry at Aster Medcity.
* Career Advancement Opportunities: Explore various pathways for professional growth within our esteemed institution.
* Supportive Work Environment: Join a dedicated and professional security team committed to maintaining high standards.
* Emphasis on Safety and Employee Well\-being: Work in an environment that prioritizes the safety and well\-being of both employees and patients.


 If you are a qualified candidate ready to enhance the safety and security at Aster Medcity, apply now for the Security Officer position and become a key part of our leading healthcare facility.
